visualCharacteristics: rc14: White band; centered H3 "In the news", then 3 white bordered news cards each with a "News" tag icon, title and "Read more" link to a newsroom article. No-image bordered cards with tag icon label, title and Read more link.

contentPattern.authoring: One row per card: one cell with tag paragraph (optional icon + text, e.g. :news: News), title heading, and link as last paragraph. An optional leading image cell is supported.

usage: Bordered news cards with a tag label, title and Read more link.
reuseGuidance: Use for newsroom / press links. Use cards-case-study for photo-led cards.
